features.name: tenure_distance_ratio
features.description: Ratio of employee tenure to commute distance, capturing the trade-off between investment in the company and commute friction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous, non-linear interaction term that linear SVMs can use to establish a margin based on commute tolerance over time.

features.name: cognitive_composite
features.description: Sum of logical and verbal scores to represent overall cognitive assessment performance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a single, smooth linear projection of cognitive ability, reducing dimensionality and improving margin stability.

features.name: training_literacy_interaction
features.description: Interaction between training score and average literacy, scaled down for numerical stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to capture the synergistic effect of baseline literacy and training performance.

features.name: cultural_alignment_index
features.description: Normalized score of similar language, representing cultural or linguistic alignment with the location.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales a percentage into a [0, 1] range, which is optimal for SVM weight regularization.

features.name: commute_burden
features.description: Distance weighted by the log of tenure, representing the accumulated burden of commuting over time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of commute fatigue that scales logarithmically, fitting well with linear decision boundaries.

features.name: cognitive_balance
features.description: Absolute difference between logical and verbal scores, indicating the skew in cognitive skill sets.
features.expected_model_benefit: Extracts a non-linear relationship (skill imbalance) into a linear feature for the SVM.

features.name: location_tenure_diff
features.description: The number of years the location has existed prior to the employee joining, floored at zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether the employee joined a mature office or a new one, providing a continuous contextual feature.

features.name: normalized_training_score
features.description: Z-score approximation of the training score using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the feature scale, which is critical for SVMs to apply uniform regularization penalties.

features.name: literacy_language_alignment
features.description: Product of normalized literacy and similar language scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a composite index of communication ease, providing a smooth continuous feature for the linear margin.

features.name: early_tenure_high_distance
features.description: Indicator for employees with less than 12 months tenure and a commute distance greater than 1.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates a specific high-risk demographic segment, allowing the linear model to assign a direct weight to this condition.

features.name: cognitive_training_efficiency
features.description: Ratio of shifted cognitive composite to training score, measuring how baseline skills translate to training outcomes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous efficiency metric that helps the SVM separate over-performers from under-performers linearly.

features.name: semantic_engagement_estimate
features.description: A semantic assessment of the employee's overall engagement and stability based on commute distance, tenure, and cultural fit, outputting a continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects domain knowledge about employee stability into a single continuous score, providing a strong linear predictor for the SVM.
